summary: S008 (Mar29) describes Culture Ministry employees protesting before Government after two actions before Finance; S009 (Mar31) says employees protested at Finance from “Friday” until yesterday and protested before Government “today” for the fifth time. The sites/actions may be the same campaign but first date and episodic structure are not fully reconciled; E005 records the distinct, dated March31 Government gathering only.
follow_up: If later authorized coverage continues, establish exact date/site sequence and whether the repeated daily actions constitute one episode; never aggregate separate-day crowds.
